AlertSubscription.title: AlertSubscription
AlertSubscription.description: Stores a farmer's saved Nakhon Ratchasima district and push-like alert trigger thresholds for SPI drought index and extreme weather events.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the farmer who owns this alert subscription.

districtId.description: Identifier of the Korat district being monitored.

districtNameTh.description: Thai name of the Korat district.

rainProbThreshold.description: Minimum rain probability percentage to trigger heavy rain/storm alerts (0-100).

maxTempThresholdC.description: Maximum temperature threshold in Celsius to trigger crop heat stress alerts (25-48).

enableExtremeWeather.description: Whether extreme weather advisories (summer storms, flash floods, heatwaves) trigger push alerts.

enableSpiAlert.description: Whether SPI drought threshold breaches trigger push alerts.

isActive.description: Whether this district alert trigger is currently active.

cropFocus.description: Primary crop monitored in this district plot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription was last updated.

AlertLog.title: AlertLog
AlertLog.description: Stores push-like notification events triggered for a farmer's saved districts.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the farmer receiving the alert.

districtId.description: Korat district ID that triggered the alert.

districtNameTh.description: Thai name of the Korat district.

alertType.description: Category of alert: spi_drought, extreme_weather, heavy_rain, or heat_stress.

severity.description: Severity level: critical, warning, or advisory.

message.description: Detailed actionable message for the farmer.

metricSummary.description: Snapshot of the triggering metric (e.g., SPI-30d -1.72 / Rain 75%).

isRead.description: Whether the farmer has acknowledged/read the notification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert was generated.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert status was last updated.

ForumPost.title: ForumPost
ForumPost.description: Public community forum post discussing agriculture, crop techniques, disease advisories, and regional questions in Nakhon Ratchasima.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the farmer who wrote this post.

authorName.description: Display name or farm identity of the author.

authorRole.description: Community role: farmer, smart_farmer, coop_leader, agri_officer, or moderator.

districtNameTh.description: Thai name of the district (e.g., อ.ด่านขุนทด, อ.พิมาย, ทุกอำเภอในโคราช).

cropTag.description: Specific agricultural crop or theme tag.

content.description: Detailed text content of the discussion.

replyCount.description: Total number of replies under this topic.

isPinned.description: Whether the moderator has pinned this topic to top.

isLocked.description: Whether the topic is locked for further replies.

isResolved.description: Whether the question has been resolved with a satisfactory answer.

moderationStatus.description: Moderation status: active, flagged, or hidden.

reportCount.description: Count of member reports against this topic.

moderatorNote.description: Official note or advisory remark appended by community moderators.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the post was last modified.

ForumReply.title: ForumReply
ForumReply.description: Reply or answer under a forum post sharing farmer insights or expert advisory.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the commenter.

districtNameTh.description: District or zone of the replier.

/alertSubscriptions/{subscriptionId}.description: Collection of district SPI and extreme weather alert triggers configured by authenticated farmers.

/alertLogs/{logId}.description: Collection of dispatched push alert notifications for authenticated farmers.

/forumPosts/{postId}.description: Public community forum posts created by Nakhon Ratchasima farmers, cooperatives, and agricultural officers.

/forumPosts/{postId}/replies/{replyId}.description: Discussion replies, agricultural advice, and comments under a forum post.
